HR2B's payroll outsourcing service pricing

HR2B's payroll service fee is calculated based on the number of employees in your business, so you only pay for what you actually use. The tables below show reference prices for businesses with Vietnamese employees only and for businesses that also employ foreign workers. Contact HR2B to receive a detailed quote tailored to your company's payroll structure.

For businesses with Vietnamese employees only

Number of employeesReference price
1 – 5 employees1,500,000 VND / month
6 – 10 employees2,000,000 VND / month
11 – 15 employees2,500,000 VND / month
16 – 20 employees3,000,000 VND / month
21 – 25 employees3,500,000 VND / month
Over 25 employees+120,000 VND / additional employee / month

For businesses with foreign employees

ServiceReference price
Payroll for foreign employeesSame pricing as businesses with Vietnamese employees only
+200,000 VND / foreign employee / month
Social insurance procedures for foreign employeesUnit code registration: 500,000 VND
Reporting increase / decrease of foreign employees: 1,000,000 VND / time
* Prices exclude VAT·Minimum contract: 3 months·Reference prices, applicable from 2026

What's included in the fee

  • Monthly payroll calculation and payroll reporting
  • Personal income tax (PIT) registration, declaration and payment
  • Social, health and unemployment insurance procedures
  • Trade union fund calculation and payment
  • Periodic labor use reports
  • Secure payslips sent to every employee

Factors that affect your price

  • Headcount – the main basis for the monthly fee
  • Foreign employees – additional fee per person and insurance procedures
  • Payroll complexity – shifts, allowances, bonuses, multiple branches
  • Additional requests beyond the standard service scope
